category_title: Grade 6 student with behavioral exceptionalities and migration-related learning difficulties
minimal_context: Dwayne is participating in a collaborative group project in the classroom with a couple of girls who volunteered to work with him.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Dwayne, you are going to work on the assignment with the girls who volunteered to have you in their group. Please get started together.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Alright, I'm taking charge! You two just sit there and I'll tell you exactly what to write down.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Remember that group work means everyone should contribute.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Speaking very loudly) I am contributing! I'm the one in charge of this group, so they just need to do what I say!

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please lower your voice and try to listen to what your group members want to do.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Oh I didn't know that I was talking that loud! But I'm not going to listen to them, I'm taking over because I know how to do it better!
